records.character: Hope Brady (adult wife/mother); Bo Brady (partner and father)
records.summary: Family chronology clarification: Hope already had live-born son Shawn-Douglas (and an earlier miscarriage) before Stefano’s Princess Gina identity-conditioning storyline. During the later Gina arc she became pregnant with Zack, ultimately confirmed as Bo’s son; Zack was born and recovered after a baby switch. A subsequent pregnancy produced Ciara, also Bo’s daughter despite Patrick’s falsified paternity results. The conditioning is technological personality/mind control, not conventional hypnotherapy; chronology does not establish that it caused conception. The later 2019–20 conditioning is a separate recurrence, not the Zack pregnancy arc.

records.kids_status: Already mother of Shawn-Douglas before Gina conditioning; earlier pregnancy loss is separate from a live birth.
records.kids_note: Bo and Hope subsequently have Zack and Ciara. Do not assign Zack or Ciara to Stefano, John or Patrick.

records.pregnancy_note: Pregnancies follow the earlier Gina conditioning in storyline chronology. No causal hypnosis/conception claim. Exact reveal, ultrasound/checkup, baby-shower and birth episode numbers remain unconfirmed under the two-independent-source rule.
